pages.title: MCP Gateway Architecture
pages.content:
# MCP Gateway

MCP Gateway exposes model-context tools to internal applications. Before a tool session is opened, the gateway authenticates the caller through Auth Service.

## Dependency

MCP Gateway consumes Auth API v1 and calls POST /v1/auth. This is a synchronous production dependency. The implementation lives in story-labs/mcp-gateway under src/auth_client.py.

MCP-101 introduced the integration. MCP-102 added the retry policy. No migration to Auth API v2 has been completed.

pages.title: MCP Authentication Runbook
pages.content:
# MCP authentication failures

The MCP Gateway client sends requests to POST /v1/auth. Retry transport failures twice. Do not retry rejected credentials.

If Auth API v1 is removed or becomes incompatible, MCP Gateway cannot start authenticated tool sessions. Check MCP-101 and the current src/auth_client.py before declaring a migration complete.
